verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents an official mem0 CLI, confirmed by a probe of its CLI docs page. The CLI adds, searches, lists, updates and deletes memories from the terminal, is described as for both humans and AI agents, and lets an agent create its own account and API key in four terminal commands. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documentation of agent-oriented details such as machine-readable output or install and auth flow depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The mem0 CLI lets you add, search, list, update, and delete memories directly from the terminal.
Manage memories from your terminal, for both humans and AI agents.
Let an AI agent create its own Mem0 account and API key in four commands, with no email or dashboard needed.
